contract: C11-D D2.0 Asset Family Audit / Contract
rules: Existing asset_family and asset_family_version remain evidence-backed metadata.
Asset roles are explicit only when supported by source evidence.
UNKNOWN is a valid state and must not be replaced by filename inference.
Matching SHA-256 alone does not justify collapsing distinct assets.
Historical assets remain reference/provenance until explicitly promoted.
No renderer, simulation, mechanics, RNG, or frozen C11-C source changes are permitted in D2.0.
